key: Add clouds to multi-viewports. Cloud code was refactored to allow the necessary rendering resources to be duplicated per viewport, as well as having viewports share many rendering resources with the main viewport. Noise scroll and flow map phases are shared between the main viewport and multi-viewports. Where possible, textures and pipelines are reused.
